implementation.discovery: Resolve the active SealSeek conversation's image inspection ability; use an attachment when the runtime cannot open a local path.

permissions: read user-selected input and bundled reference images
mappings.normalization: Return visible observations and input identity without changing any file. If original-detail inspection is unavailable, return FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED.

implementation.discovery: Resolve by exact server and native tool identity from the current advertised MCP catalog; inspect the live schema before a paid call.

permissions: upload only the user's edit target and the one or two selected bundled references
mappings.invocation: Pass one input target plus one or two selected preset references in an explicit ordered set. Name each role in the prompt. Use one output per attempt and only live-schema-supported model, reference and aspect-ratio fields. If the live schema cannot accept the three images or return a usable artifact, stop with FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED; do not drop a reference or switch backend silently.
mappings.normalization: Return the generated artifact as a local file path or a native media reference that can be saved locally for the exact-size CLI normalization step.

implementation.discovery: Resolve the installed CLI from the SealSeek runtime PATH or the installed npm package entry; run doctor --json.

permissions: write only the user-selected output and package-managed Skill/cache locations
mappings.normalization: Return the CLI JSON result, exit status and any error code.
